titulo: The conditional: requests, advice and hypotheses: Advice and hypotheses

aula.titulo: The conditional: requests, advice and hypotheses
aula.objetivo: Form the conditional, make polite requests, give advice and talk about hypotheses with «si» + imparfait.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: to imagine an unreal or unlikely situation: «si» + imparfait, result in the conditional: «Si j'avais de l'argent, je voyagerais.» (If I had money, I would travel.) STEP 2: the order can be reversed: «Je voyagerais si j'avais de l'argent.» STEP 3: NEVER use the conditional after «si»: «Si j'aurais» is a mistake. STEP 4: «si» + imparfait, in the sense of a suggestion: «Si on allait au cinéma ?» (what if we went?) STEP 5: to give advice, «à ta place, je + conditional»: «À ta place, je dormirais plus.» STEP 6: to talk about a dream: «Je voudrais habiter à la mer.» «J'aimerais parler français.» STEP 7: three types of «si»: «Si tu viens, nous irons» (likely: present + future). «Si tu venais, nous irions» (unlikely: imparfait + conditional). «Si tu étais venu, nous serions allés» (past: B1). STEP 8: question: «Que ferais-tu si tu gagnais au loto ?»
blocos.comparacao: In English: «if I had, I would do». French does exactly the same with «si» + imparfait + conditional. The typical mistake is to put the conditional after «si» as well, as some English speakers do in speech ('if I would have').

tabela.example: Si tu viens, nous irons au cinéma.
Si j'avais de l'argent, je voyagerais.

erros.errado: Si j'aurais de l'argent, je voyagerais.
erros.certo: Si j'avais de l'argent, je voyagerais.

erros.errado: Si j'avais de l'argent, je voyagerai.
erros.certo: Si j'avais de l'argent, je voyagerais.

erros.errado: À ta place, je dors plus.
erros.certo: À ta place, je dormirais plus.

blocos.enunciado: Say aloud eight sentences: «Si j'avais… , je… » about what you would do if you won the lottery.
Conjugate aloud «aller, faire, pouvoir, vouloir» in the conditional with «je».
